description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Java 25 is the latest LTS release, bringing improved performance, security patches, and modern language features. Upgrading ensures long-term support and access to the latest JVM improvements.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the project JDK/Java version to 25. Update build configuration (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 25. Ensure all compiler settings, toolchain configurations, and CI/CD pipelines reference Java 25. Validate that all dependencies are compatible with Java 25.
tasks.summary: Upgraded project from Java 21 to Java 25. Updated pom.xml java.version property and Dockerfile base images. Spring Boot 4.0.1 is natively compatible with Java 25. Build and all unit tests pass.
